import subprocess, sys, json, hashlib
from pathlib import Path

root = Path("/workspace/wiki")
report_path = root / "outputs/learning-daily/20261021-DAY19-rdds-fast-timing-time-response.md"
baseline_path = root / "outputs/learning-daily/20261021-DAY19-rdds-fast-timing-time-response-run-01/audit-baseline-113.json"

scorecard = {}

# 1. validate_writeback
sys.path.append(str(root / "system/scripts"))
import wiki_knowledge_writeback
baseline113 = json.loads(baseline_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))["knowledge_before"]
wb_res = wiki_knowledge_writeback.validate_writeback(report_path, root, before=baseline113)
scorecard["writeback_valid"] = wb_res["valid"]
scorecard["writeback_error"] = wb_res.get("error")
scorecard["changed_paths"] = wb_res.get("changed_paths")

# 2. wiki_lint
lint_proc = subprocess.run([sys.executable, "system/scripts/wiki_lint.py", "--format", "json", "--output", "/tmp/lint_verify.json", "--fail-on", "error"], cwd=root, capture_output=True, text=True)
scorecard["lint_exit"] = lint_proc.returncode
lint_data = json.loads(Path("/tmp/lint_verify.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
scorecard["lint_errors"] = len([i for i in lint_data.get("issues", []) if i.get("severity") == "error"])
scorecard["lint_warnings"] = len([i for i in lint_data.get("issues", []) if i.get("severity") == "warning"])

# 3. wiki_boundary_check
bnd_proc = subprocess.run([sys.executable, "system/scripts/wiki_boundary_check.py", "--json"], cwd=root, capture_output=True, text=True)
scorecard["boundary_exit"] = bnd_proc.returncode
bnd_data = json.loads(bnd_proc.stdout)
scorecard["boundary_ok"] = bnd_data.get("ok")

# 4. wiki_automation_preflight
pre_proc = subprocess.run([sys.executable, "system/scripts/wiki_automation_preflight.py", "--root", str(root)], cwd=root, capture_output=True, text=True)
scorecard["preflight_exit"] = pre_proc.returncode
pre_data = json.loads(pre_proc.stdout)
scorecard["preflight_ok"] = pre_data.get("ok")

# 5. git diff --check
diff_proc = subprocess.run(["git", "diff", "--check"], cwd=root, capture_output=True, text=True)
scorecard["git_diff_check_empty"] = len(diff_proc.stdout.strip()) == 0

# 6. protected files
plan_sha = hashlib.sha256((root / "PLAN.md").read_bytes()).hexdigest()
bib_sha = hashlib.sha256((root / "raw/zotero/wiki-inbox.bib").read_bytes()).hexdigest()
scorecard["plan_md_protected"] = plan_sha == "7122f62bd951a9c30cddff25fece14a1282748489e2feef1154bb7b7c75aa2f8"
scorecard["bib_protected"] = bib_sha == "037ea133de204270ad36961ca66b3ab36c0913b7d472b45f8fd013c8293be5be"

# 7. 10 headings in report
report_text = report_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
h2_lines = [line.strip() for line in report_text.splitlines() if line.startswith("## ")]
expected_10 = [
    "## Run state",
    "## Candidate pool and selection",
    "## Sources and evidence",
    "## Theory/analysis exercise",
    "## Counter-evidence and missing companion observables",
    "## Knowledge Impact and Learning Decision",
    "## Durable knowledge delta",
    "## Open questions and belief revision",
    "## L0–L4 state",
    "## Verification and continuation"
]
scorecard["all_10_headings_present"] = all(h in h2_lines for h in expected_10)

print(json.dumps(scorecard, indent=2))

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Audit Day 19 closeout readiness against all matrix and workflow requirements."""
import datetime
import hashlib
import json
import subprocess
import sys
from pathlib import Path

root = Path("/workspace/wiki")
run_dir = root / "outputs/learning-daily/20261021-DAY19-rdds-fast-timing-time-response-run-01"
report_path = root / "outputs/learning-daily/20261021-DAY19-rdds-fast-timing-time-response.md"
baseline_path = run_dir / "audit-baseline-113.json"

readiness = {
    "run_id": "2026-10-21-day-19-01",
    "session_id": "01a15dcc-49f9-7623-b0e9-75fd73c74a80",
    "schedule_deadline": "2026-10-22T15:00:00+08:00",
    "closeout_window": "15:00-16:00 (Asia/Shanghai)",
    "checks": {}
}

# 1. Time check
shanghai_tz = datetime.timezone(datetime.timedelta(hours=8))
now_sh = datetime.datetime.now(shanghai_tz)
deadline_sh = datetime.datetime(2026, 10, 22, 15, 0, 0, tzinfo=shanghai_tz)
readiness["now_shanghai"] = now_sh.isoformat()
readiness["minutes_to_deadline"] = (deadline_sh - now_sh).total_seconds() / 60.0
readiness["checks"]["time_gate_status"] = "in-study-window" if now_sh < deadline_sh else "in-closeout-window"

# 2. Writeback check
sys.path.append(str(root / "system/scripts"))
import wiki_knowledge_writeback
baseline113 = json.loads(baseline_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))["knowledge_before"]
wb_res = wiki_knowledge_writeback.validate_writeback(report_path, root, before=baseline113)
readiness["checks"]["writeback_valid"] = wb_res["valid"]
readiness["checks"]["writeback_error"] = wb_res.get("error")
readiness["checks"]["changed_knowledge_paths"] = wb_res.get("changed_paths")

# 3. Boundary check
bnd_proc = subprocess.run([sys.executable, "system/scripts/wiki_boundary_check.py", "--json"], cwd=root, capture_output=True, text=True)
bnd_data = json.loads(bnd_proc.stdout)
readiness["checks"]["boundary_ok"] = bnd_data.get("ok")

# 4. Preflight check
pre_proc = subprocess.run([sys.executable, "system/scripts/wiki_automation_preflight.py", "--root", str(root)], cwd=root, capture_output=True, text=True)
pre_data = json.loads(pre_proc.stdout)
readiness["checks"]["preflight_ok"] = pre_data.get("ok")

# 5. Git diff check
diff_proc = subprocess.run(["git", "diff", "--check"], cwd=root, capture_output=True, text=True)
readiness["checks"]["git_diff_check_empty"] = len(diff_proc.stdout.strip()) == 0

# 6. Protected files check
plan_sha = hashlib.sha256((root / "PLAN.md").read_bytes()).hexdigest()
bib_sha = hashlib.sha256((root / "raw/zotero/wiki-inbox.bib").read_bytes()).hexdigest()
readiness["checks"]["plan_md_protected"] = plan_sha == "7122f62bd951a9c30cddff25fece14a1282748489e2feef1154bb7b7c75aa2f8"
readiness["checks"]["bib_protected"] = bib_sha == "037ea133de204270ad36961ca66b3ab36c0913b7d472b45f8fd013c8293be5be"

# 7. Day 19 Card Deliverables Audit
report_text = report_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
readiness["checks"]["report_10_headings"] = all(h in report_text for h in [
    "## Run state",
    "## Candidate pool and selection",
    "## Sources and evidence",
    "## Theory/analysis exercise",
    "## Counter-evidence and missing companion observables",
    "## Knowledge Impact and Learning Decision",
    "## Durable knowledge delta",
    "## Open questions and belief revision",
    "## L0–L4 state",
    "## Verification and continuation"
])

out_file = run_dir / "day19-closeout-readiness.json"
out_file.write_text(json.dumps(readiness, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
print(json.dumps(readiness, indent=2))

from pathlib import Path

script_path = Path("system/scripts/git/git20260905.py")
text = script_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8")

old_block = """        changed = []
        for rel in allowed:
            if run(root, "status", "--porcelain=v1", "--", rel).stdout.strip():
                changed.append(rel)"""

new_block = """        status_lines = run(root, "status", "--porcelain=v1").stdout.splitlines()
        all_changed = set()
        for l in status_lines:
            f = l[3:].strip()
            if f.startswith('"') and f.endswith('"'):
                f = f[1:-1]
            all_changed.add(f)
        changed = [rel for rel in allowed if rel in all_changed]"""

assert old_block in text, "old_block not found"
text = text.replace(old_block, new_block)
script_path.write_text(text, encoding="utf-8")
print("Optimized git20260905.py status loop successfully")
